summary: GitHub's page for its two open-source variable brand fonts (Mona Sans and Hubot Sans), built as a product-marketing page inside github.com's own header and footer: a 3D-rendered mascot hero under a stacked wordmark, a twin intro card and basic glyph grid per family, a blue weight/width/slant sandbox with a Mona↔Hubot switch, a staggered poster wall, scroll-faded slogans and a 'free under OFL, send a pull request' close. Compared with foundry sites it sells adoption and community, not licences: brand mascots and animated emoji replace type history, and every CTA goes to a GitHub repository.

instances.look: github.com's global dark header (72px): octocat logo, Platform · Solutions · Resources · Open Source · Enterprise · Pricing dropdowns, search field, Sign in / Sign up; not specific to the fonts

Deep navy radial glow with the curve of a dark planet at the bottom; a tiny condensed kicker 'TWO VARIABLE, OPEN SOURCE FONTS from GITHUB'; a huge white stacked wordmark 'MONA / & / HUBOT / SANS' in four different widths, weights and slants; a glossy 3D render of the robot Hubot holding the octocat Mona, who holds a glowing 'T' font file, overlapping the last word; under it, 'Two files. / Thousands of variations. / Infinite possibilities.' in thin grey-lilac type
instances.ux: No buttons in the first screen; the mascots build in as the page scrolls (js-build-in-trigger) and the tagline's letters are split into spans for a per-character build-in
instances.learn: Make the wordmark itself the range demo: each line of the stacked name uses a different family, width, weight and slant (font-stretch 83%, extra-condensed, italic heavy), so the logo shows the design space

instances.look: Two parallel family cards: a hairline-ruled header with the name in wide extrabold caps ('MONA SANS', 'HUBOT SANS') and a small mascot icon at the right; a 4–5 line description at ~64px ('A strong and versatile typeface, designed with Degarism and inspired by industrial-era grotesques…', 'Mona's robotic sidekick. More geometric accents…'), a looping animated emoji (Mona with hearts) or a 3D Hubot flying past a giant white '&', and two buttons
